thread:
maria: Heads-up — need to lock down the API auth surface for chat + function-calling before next sprint. DeltaHealth pushed for per-project API keys + key rotation guarantees. Can we surface tradeoffs?

alex: +1. We should decide project vs org key semantics first. What exact guarantees do they need on rotation?

maria: They want 1) ability to create project-scoped keys for teams, 2) rotation without downtime (grace period), 3) audit trail that ties tokens to projects/users.

nick: For rotation without downtime we can do overlapping valid windows: new key active immediately, old key accepted for N minutes. Need to define N. 5m typical, but for large fleets maybe 15m.

sam: Agree. Also need automatic revocation API for compromised keys. Customers expect immediate revoke + invalidation of KV cache for sessions.

alex: Implementation notes: runtime accepts both active keys until expiry. Need to store key->project mapping in fast lookup (redis) for per-token routing. Also ensure we include org-admin keys that bypass project quotas.

maria: Launch criteria proposal: (a) per-project key creation UI + API, (b) rotation endpoint + grace window, (c) revoke endpoint, (d) audit logs surfaced in Console (last 90d), (e) clear default quotas per project and org.

tasha: Question: function-calling and structured outputs — do keys map to allowed tool set? Some customers want restricting which tools a project key can call.

nick: We can add a token-scoped "capabilities" field. Default: full. Optional: restrict to embeddings-only, no external tools, or deny file access. Simple RBAC attached to key metadata.

sam: Ops consideration: rotation spike — when many clients poll new keys at once it can blow up auth DB. Suggest we pre-warm caches and return a short-lived signed JWT for runtime with local validation to reduce DB hits.

alex: Example API for rotation we discussed:
```
POST /v1/keys/rotate
{ "key_id": "k_123", "overlap_minutes": 10 }
// returns new_key, old_key_expires_at
```

maria: Docs/UI: need to show how to rotate safely in CI/CD. Provide a sample workflow for customers (create new key, update environment, wait for tasks to restart, revoke old key). Keep wording explicit.

tasha: For private deployments we need KMS/HSM integration for key material. That should be a separate checkbox in Private/Enterprise plans.

sam: Also add a telemetry rollout flag so we can monitor auth latencies and error spikes during early customers. devex-bot can toggle.

devex-bot: @maria telemetry: auth.latency p50/p95 dashboards provisioned in staging.

alex: Back to launch: we should prioritize APIs work > console polish > docs. Minimum shippable: API + rotation + revoke + audit log stream. Console and fine-grained capability UI can be beta.

maria: Customer asks prioritized: DeltaHealth (high) -> per-project keys + rotation; CloudSMB (medium) -> per-key quotas and basic capability limits; PublicBeta users (low) -> console polish.

nick: Security checklist: KMS integration, HSM for private, audit trail, short-lived JWT option, revocation endpoint, alerting on mass key churn.

sam: Action items:
- alex: implement rotate + revoke endpoints + JWT issuance (sprint 1)
- nick: design key metadata model (capabilities, project_id, created_by, rotate_window) + schema (ASAP)
- tasha: spec console beta flows + docs snippets (sprint 1)
- maria: customer comms and launch criteria sign-off

maria: Can everyone ack? If no blockers we'll put API work in next sprint and console beta in following.

alex: Ack

nick: Ack

tasha: Ack

sam: Ack

maria: Great. I'll open a PR with the proposed launch checklist and link customer asks. We'll include an example migration doc for customers with long-lived tokens. :thumbsup:
